title: P-0019 Template Contract
headline: One-page CVs: designed, not built
next_move: Answer the five decisions, then copy them to me

needs_you.title: Approve the proposal?
needs_you.context: People who saw a designed CV called it beautiful but not practical for ordinary jobs. They want one clear page. Today the engine has no way to offer two kinds of the same design, and nothing records which one a client chose.
needs_you.decision: Whether to adopt P-0019. It makes a Template a design language with named Variations, and gives Domains and Templates a versioned contract saying what each supports.
needs_you.example: Flagship would have two Variations: Showcase, today's bold design, and Essential, one scan-first page. A client picks one, and the same facts work with both.

needs_you.title: How do we judge Essential?

options.label: Quieter Three-Second Test
options.detail: Career area still readable at a glance

needs_you.context: Every CV must pass the Three-Second Test: the page shouts the career area, specialty and rank. Essential is calm on purpose, so that test would fail it. Flagship Parity also asks for a portrait and a ship in the page.
needs_you.decision: Which test a scan-first design has to pass. With the Scan Test, Flagship Parity and the Batch Test would judge craft, not loudness.
needs_you.example: A reader gets the page for ten seconds. Can they say the name, the current job, the employer, the dates and the education? If yes, it passes.

needs_you.title: Change the vision's wording?

options.label: Add a scan-first exception
options.detail: The bold rule stays for the rest

options.label: Keep the vision as it is

needs_you.context: The vision says a design that is well crafted but quiet fails, and calls safe professional a defect. A deliberately calm Essential breaks that sentence. The research found the audience for ordinary jobs wants exactly that calm.
needs_you.decision: Whether the vision makes room for a second kind of CV. This changes what CVgen calls a failure, so it is yours alone.
needs_you.example: "A design that is well crafted but quiet fails, except under a scan-first bar, which is its own."

needs_you.title: Freeze one reference per Variation?
needs_you.context: A Frozen Reference is the approved PDF the suite compares every render against, pixel by pixel. It is what stops a look from drifting. The constitution allows one per Template.
needs_you.decision: Whether the constitution moves to one Frozen Reference per Variation, so that Showcase and Essential each have their own.
needs_you.example: Change Showcase's margins and only Showcase's reference fails. Change Essential and only its reference fails. Each look can then move on its own.

needs_you.title: Where does the work start?
needs_you.context: Essential needs a Template to live in, and only marine has one. TASK-3 changes marine's deck facts, so doing it first avoids restructuring Flagship twice. The feedback came from a travel client, who gains nothing until the travel Domain exists.
needs_you.decision: Which comes first: marine, where a Template exists, or travel, where the feedback came from.
needs_you.example: With TASK-3 first, deck contract periods enter the contract at version 1. Without it, the same facts arrive later as the first version 2, and Flagship changes twice.

decisions.title: Build in two stages
decisions.why: Stage 1 gives you Essential and the checks. Version comparison waits until a Domain first changes, since until then it has nothing to compare.

decisions.title: Version lives in candidate.json
decisions.why: The facts' shape is recorded with the facts, and a record without a version counts as 1. The frozen example records stay unedited.

decisions.title: Any contract change raises the version
decisions.why: Raising it only for group changes would have hidden a breaking change to a single group.

decisions.title: Report lives in the brand folder
decisions.why: It is CVgen's own house asset, not a CV. An agent fills in a JSON file and never touches the page.

evidence.caption: One record in two Themes: with a reference per Variation, each look is frozen
